name: h3yun-connector
description: With the H3Yun connector, businesses can quickly turn everyday operations into configurable, collaborative, and traceable digital applications. It supports rapid app creation, business data management, and workflow-driven approvals and task routing, making it suitable for a wide range of scenarios including customer, project, procurement, inventory, and after-sales management.

display.name: 氚云
display.description_zh: 通过氚云连接器，将日常业务快速构建为可配置、可协同、可追踪的数字化应用。支持快速创建应用表单、管理业务数据、以流程驱动审批与任务流转，适用于客户、项目、采购、库存、售后等多类业务管理场景。
